description.value: Fern + Cedar is a purpose-built brewpub in the heart of downtown Qualicum Beach, combining a small-batch 10HL brewhouse — visible from the dining room — with a West Coast gastropub kitchen led by a veteran local chef. Beers are brewed exclusively on-site using BC-sourced ingredients and are unavailable anywhere else, making it a genuine destination stop. The open-air taproom features live hanging greenery and a year-round dog-friendly patio.
